The power was switched off this morning at 09:30 to enable our engineers to replace and upgrade a piece of equipment called a transformer on Black Horse Drove. Now completed, this work should improve the voltage in your area and help provide you with a more reliable electricity supply, reducing the risk of unexpected power cuts. We would like to apologise for any inconvenience caused and thank you for your patience. We always aim to provide a 10/10 service, if you feel we have not given you a 10 out of 10 service then please call 105. Our reference number for these works is: INCD-27175-O.

PlannedIncidentReason: We recently carried out work in your area during the planned power cut on 7 September. Since then, we're aware that some customers have continued to experience voltage issues. Our engineers have investigated this further and identified that a transformer now needs to be replaced and upgraded. Completing this work should improve the voltage in your area and help provide you with a more reliable electricity supply, reducing the risk of unexpected power cuts. To carry out this work safely, we will need to temporarily switch off your electricity, as it is not safe to work on electrical equipment while it is live. We will remove the existing transformer and install a new one on the same day. We understand that power interruptions are inconvenient, and we will do everything we can to keep disruption to a minimum. This work is taking place on Black Horse Drove.
MainMessage: The electricity supply to your premises may currently be affected by planned work.  You should have received a letter explaining this.  We hope to be able to restore your supplies by 02-OCT-2026 14:30.  Please accept our sincere apologies for any inconvenience this is causing.

Logs.Comment:
Sent by Lisa at 09:48 - I am glad to report that power to the Parker Street area should now be back on.

I'm sorry for the continued disruption recently. We believe there may be a fault on our underground electricity cabling in the area, but currently it has not developed to a stage that our staff can pinpoint it. Their tests have proven inconclusive, so for now they have replaced our safety equipment at the substation to get your power back on as quickly as possible.

This may happen again before we're able to fix it, but if you'd like to talk to us about this, or if your power isn't on call us on 08003163105 which is free from landlines and mobiles.

Our staff have now arrived on site in the Parker Street area. Due to there being multiple power cuts over a short space of time, our engineers are going to be testing if the network is still healthy.

They will start at the substation, and often apply specialist equipment that may turn your power back on for a brief period, so don't worry if your power comes on and goes off again. They will also check smaller sites which run along our cabling route, these break our network down into smaller sections and can help pinpoint any possible problems.

Our estimated time frame of 12:00 and 13:00 hasn't changed, so I'll let you know more once our staff update us. Sent by Lisa at 08:52.

Sent by Lisa at 08:36 - Our staff are on the way to the Parker Street area as our safety equipment within the nearby substation has operated.

We believe a developing cable fault is causing these repeat power cuts, so while our estimated time frame to have power back on is currently between 12:00 and 13:00, it's possible this may need to change once staff have assessed. This is because every power cut increases the chance of the fault has developing to a point that our specialist teams can pinpoint it using specialist equipment. I'll let you know once our teams arrive.
